notes: Turn 1 double Stimhack on an open R&D took 2 core damage for credits it never spent, which cut hand size to 3. After that it re-ran the same unchanged R&D top card 3 times a turn for 10 turns, drew into discards while rich, and never contested the remote the Corp kept scoring from.

Scored efficiently out of an iced remote and finished with a fast install-and-score using Jeeves. It went down to 0 credits early and spent turns 12-14 clicking for credits while rich instead of advancing agendas, though the passive Runner never punished this.

Got through to an Obokata Protocol and declined to steal it, then spent about 8 turns clicking for credits (up to 43) while the Corp re-advanced and scored it from the same server. It woke up late, and Engolo/Ika plus remote pressure won the game anyway.
Sensible scoring tempo with AstroScript, and it read correctly that the Runner's Eater runs could not access anything. Its only flaw was idle click-for-credit turns at 14-20 credits.

Steady single R&D runs won the game, but it padded each turn with click-for-credit while holding nothing to spend on. It never went back to an HQ that grew to 14 cards, even though Aumakua could break Fairchild.

Put Beale and then a second agenda in the same one-ice remote, and both were stolen in back-to-back turns. From turn 21 it repeated 'pay 2 to trash Earthrise Hotel' plus 2 clicks for credits every turn at 2 credits, discarding each turn, until it decked.

Reinstalled Eater for 4 credits about 15 times, only for Archangel to bounce it on the next R&D run each time, and it did the same with Daily Casts. It stayed tagged for long stretches, so the Corp could keep trashing its resources.
Spent to 0 credits on turn 1 and then re-ran an unchanged open R&D 4 times a turn. It sat at 3 cards and low credits against Weyland, and Posted Bounty plus Scorched Earth flatlined it.

With no early economy it could never rez its HQ ice, and the Runner took three agendas from HQ to reach 6 points. It also forfeited Posted Bounty for a tag it had no follow-up for; Snare and a late Scorched Earth saved the game.
The Audacity fast-advance and steady remote scoring were fine. But it left R&D unprotected all game while the Runner ran it 4 times a turn, and played Hard-Hitting News with no follow-up.
Built 111 credits and a 28-card HQ against a broke Runner but stopped installing agendas after turn 3. It kept drawing (Violet Level Clearance, click draws) until it decked itself.
Good R&D pressure, trashed Marilyn, and punished Audacity's discards with an Archives win. Minor issues: a pointless Mad Dash into an empty Archives and a repeat R&D run on the same Jeeves.

Played Dedication Ceremony twice on the Runner's D4v1d. It lost three agendas from one-ice remotes, twice behind a Vanilla the Runner was already breaking every turn, and it overdrew with repeated Violet Level Clearance until it decked.
Re-ran an unchanged open R&D 3-4 times a turn. Then it accessed the same Fetal AI three times in one turn without paying the 2 credits to steal it, although it had 8, and flatlined itself.
Solid economy and setup, trashed Nico Campaigns, and used Cleaver and Jailbreak to win through HQ. It could have started pressuring HQ a turn or two earlier.
Good Jinteki trap play: a naked Fetal AI cost the Runner cards, and Mushin No Shin on Junebug flatlined it. Its economy was thin, and it double-iced a remote it never used.

Reached 6 points by turn 5, then never ran Server 1 again while the Corp installed and scored 5 agendas there over 14 turns. Meanwhile it sat on 20-30 credits, clicking for credits and making pointless Archives and HQ runs.

Spent 8 straight turns clicking for credits up to 31 and discarding, with no installs, then used Divert Power just to derez and rerez its own Anansi. The later remote fortress scored, but R&D's single ice was never rezzed and gave up an Obokata.
Seamless Launch gave an early score, it rebuilt economy well, and it scored behind a layered remote. It left HQ open early and hoarded about 40 credits with idle credit clicks.

Early R&D steal, then it re-ran an unchanged R&D 4 times a turn on 1 credit while repeated Hard-Hitting News tags drained it. With 14 credits and MKUltra able to break the Enigma, it did not run the remote where GFI sat for the winning score.
